_comment: Settings for the simulation harness (combat rework S8): tools/policy_comparison.gd, run by tools/batch_sim.gd with --policies. Not a scenario: files starting with _ are skipped when scenarios are listed.
_policies_comment: policies: who plays the squad, in table order (FightScenario policy names). runs: seeded fights per policy; every policy plays the same seeds. scenario: the scenario played when none is named (TODO(decision: sandbox-scenario): S9's sandbox replaces this file's stand-in). csv_dir: where fights.csv and policies.csv are written.
_checks_comment: The deep dive's exit checks. clean_policy plays well, careless_policy greedily. Greedy test: careless loses at least clear_gap_percent more HP than clean, and more grid capacity. Action-share test: no action above max_action_share_percent of the clean policy's squad decisions. Clean-win gap: on the seeds both win, careless loses at least clear_gap_percent more HP.
